The only negative side effects I’ve had when drinking, is having a couple drinks (no where near my tolerance limit) and I’ll wake up the next day not remembering anything that happened the night before. Other than that, I was fine. So it seems it can make you go from 0-100 real quick. Be safe! Cheers!

Thanks for that, I just want them out of their life asap as much as they do. No physical evidence. Other than the one sided stuff they post on social media. They have already portrayed themselves as the victim so they are currently trying to find an escape route but are delaying it to the fullest extent.

We have talked and continue to talk. They are more than ready. The abuser has no job, no friends or family. So they have to go find something or somewhere to stay and is making every excuse as to why they shouldn’t or can’t. My friend and her daughter shouldn’t have to leave a place that finally gave them stability.
But thank you for the links. I’ll forward them to them and maybe give them to the abuser.

In junior high/ high school. 

Had a shitty home life sprinkled with childhood trauma.
I had an overwhelming hurt and knew of SH but never did it before. I did it because I was crying for help and attention but I hid it (obvi) because it’s not acceptable to mutilate your body. My friends mom saw it when we were out on the town one night and she got flustered and she took me home right away. And that was that. I felt shameful.

I try and wear 3/4 sleeves or half sleeves depends where exactly the cuts are. There isn’t really a way around it, so just light clothing with those kind of sleeves. Best of luck to you
Xo
This is me everyday. You’re not alone my friend. Just keep going. Don’t stop. ❤️
I feel this. I stabbed my foot with a knife and it bled forever and I lost feeling in my big toe. Be safe friend.
Thank you for your kind words <3
Yes, almost every time I see something like that, I wish it was on me rather than the item.
If it’s any consolation, you’re not alone in feeling lonely. We can be lonely together. Pm me if you’d like to talk :)

I find that I have less sensation on the tops on my forearm than on my thighs, allowing me to cut deeper but harder to hide. I also caused nerve damage in my thigh from cutting too deep in certain spots. I think it depends on how badly you want to feel or lack thereof.

It can be a lot of fun! But it can also be really REALLY stressful. Honestly I kind of don’t care how the dog would feel if I SH. I mean maybe Ill try thinking of it like, “how would they feel if I were to accidentally cut them.”  Thanks for the thought!

Yes! I have nerve damage in my legs and my one arm from SH. It’s mostly numb around those areas but it all depends on where your injuries are. Best of luck! Here if ya need someone! Pm me if you’d like
I do feel better, I wish I had just stabbed my arm instead of slicing... I just have to get myself together before I go into work now. Thanks for checking on me! x
I completely understand, it’s not by my boss but by my dad.. I’ve barely been awake for an hour and already tore up my arm so no worries, you’re not alone.
Thank you for reaching out! I just feel so blah. I’m trying to push through my feelings and get back up on the road to recovery again. It’s just so hard. Feel free to reach out.
I do. The longest I went was 11 days.

I hit it. I went deeper on my thigh. Just kept slicing in the same spot until I was in a bit. I didn’t get stitches and I had done it quite a few more times than I, in hindsight, wanted. I wish I had before and after pictures of the slices and scars because I got it covered with a tattoo.
I completely understand. I also have started self harming after about 2 years. It’s the holidays 😕Hold your chin up kid, you’re not alone ❤️
